in_sanskrit.name: Naved
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rest, Repose
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Naved एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Persian word 'naw-id', meaning 'rest', 'repose', or 'new beginning'. In Hinduism, Naved is a popular name for boys and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
